name: hydrascript
description: Pythonic Syntax for React & Modern Web Applications — Standalone native Rust compiler with zero runtime overhead
author: Reyhan Akhtar Afriansyah (Hanz)

scripts.build:compiler: cd compiler-rs && cargo build --release && cp target/release/hydra ../bin/hydra && cp target/release/libhydra.so ../bin/hydra.node
scripts.test: cd compiler-rs && cargo test && cd .. && node --test packages/cli/plugin.test.mjs packages/cli/server.test.mjs packages/cli/entrypoint.test.mjs packages/cli/dts.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node --test packages/cli/plugin.test.mjs packages/cli/server.test.mjs packages/cli/entrypoint.test.mjs packages/cli/dts.test.mjs && bash scripts/pack-install-check.sh
